info.title: jex - Jex Clean Architecture CLI
info.description: Command-line tool for the Jex Clean Architecture template: create projects (jex new), scaffold features (jex scaffold), and run the build/test/database/infrastructure workflow of a generated solution (jex check, jex run, jex db, jex infra).

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: jex - create, scaffold, build and run Jex Clean Architecture solutions.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: build
commands.description: Build the solution.

commands.name: format
commands.description: Apply code formatting to the solution.

options.name: --check
options.description: Verify formatting without changing files (dotnet format --verify-no-changes). [default: False]

commands.name: test
commands.description: Run the tests.

arguments.name: SUITE
arguments.description: Run only one test project: unit, integration or arch. Default: the whole solution.

commands.name: check
commands.description: The acceptance gate: format, build, test. Stops at the first failing step.

options.name: --ci
options.description: Same as CI: verify formatting, Release build with warnings as errors, tests without rebuilding. [default: False]

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run the API (Development), or the Aspire AppHost with --aspire.

options.name: --aspire
options.description: Run the .NET Aspire AppHost instead of the API. [default: False]

options.name: --api-project
options.description: Web API project to use (path to the .csproj or its directory). Default: the only *.WebAPI.csproj in the solution.

commands.description: Run the API with hot reload.

commands.description: Mark the current directory (a solution generated before jex existed) as a jex project by writing jex.json.

commands.name: new
commands.description: Create a solution from the Jex template (installs the matching template package if needed). Other options are passed to 'dotnet new jex'.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory. Default: ./<name>.

options.name: --database
options.description: Database provider: sqlite (default), postgresql, sqlserver, mysql.

options.name: --use-aspire
options.description: Add a .NET Aspire AppHost project. [default: False]

options.name: --include-ai-docs
options.description: Include AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, skills and Copilot instructions (default true). [default: False]

options.name: --include-docker
options.description: Include Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml (default true). [default: False]

options.name: --http-port
options.description: HTTP port in launchSettings.json (random if omitted).

options.name: --https-port
options.description: HTTPS port in launchSettings.json (random if omitted).

options.name: --skip-restore
options.description: Do not restore packages after generating. [default: False]

options.name: --template-version
options.description: Template package version to use (installed if needed). Default: the version of this jex.

options.name: --no-install
options.description: Never install or switch the template package; fail instead. [default: False]

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Project name, e.g. Acme.Shop (also the root namespace).

commands.name: dev
commands.description: Develop the Jex template repository: install templates from source, generate sandboxes, run the matrix.

commands.name: install
commands.description: Install the templates from this checkout (dev loop, no pack needed).

options.name: --from-package
options.description: Pack the template package and install the nupkg (release acceptance path). [default: False]

options.name: --version
options.description: Package version for --from-package. [default: 0.0.0-dev]

commands.name: uninstall
commands.description: Remove the Jex templates (directory and package installs).

commands.name: pack
commands.description: Pack the template package and the Jex.Cli tool package with the same version.

options.name: --version
options.description: Version of both packages. [default: 0.0.0-dev]

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory. [default: artifacts]

commands.name: new
commands.description: Regenerate artifacts/sandbox/<name> from the installed templates and assert its structure.

options.name: --database
options.description: Database provider. [default: sqlite]

options.name: --aspire
options.description: --use-aspire. [default: False]

options.name: --ai
options.description: --include-ai-docs. [default: True]

options.name: --docker
options.description: --include-docker. [default: True]

options.name: --check
options.description: Then run the strict gate (check --ci) in the sandbox, in this process. [default: False]

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Project name (artifacts/sandbox/<name>), e.g. Acme, Acme.Shop, my-api.

commands.name: matrix
commands.description: Generate, assert, scaffold (with jex) and check every supported template combination.

options.name: --cells
options.description: Comma-separated cells (sqlite, postgresql, sqlserver, mysql, aspire, bare). Default: all.

options.name: --package
options.description: Test this template nupkg instead of ./templates.

options.name: --docker
options.description: Also docker build the cells that have a Dockerfile. [default: False]

options.name: --jex
options.description: Executable of the jex CLI under test. Default: this jex.

options.name: --jex-arg
options.description: Argument placed before every jex command (repeatable), e.g. the Jex.Cli.dll path when --jex is dotnet.

commands.name: install-cli
commands.description: Pack this checkout's CLI as 0.0.0-dev and (re)install it as the global 'jex' tool. Run it with 'dotnet run --project src/Jex.Cli -- dev install-cli'.

options.name: --output
options.description: Directory for the packed tool. [default: artifacts]

commands.name: check
commands.description: Format, build and test the template source (templates/solution), in this process.

options.name: --ci
options.description: Same as CI: verify formatting, warnings as errors. [default: False]

commands.name: clean
commands.description: Delete bin/obj under templates/ and the artifacts/ directory.
